components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal action button for principal user submissions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #56c9bf; border-radius: 6px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 760; background: #56c9bf; color: #090d10; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #348b84; border-color: #348b84; color: #edf5f5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action button for tertiary control actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(205, 235, 235, 0.18); border-radius: 6px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 760; background: #172329; color: #c4d1d3; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(86, 201, 191, 0.28); color: #56c9bf; background: rgba(86, 201, 191, 0.11); }

narrative.overview: Label Guardian is a quiet, dark tech workspace optimized for perception data auditing. The design recedes into the background so that label data and bounding box annotations remain the focus of the reviewer's cognitive load.

rules.name: The Rarity of Brand Color Rule
rules.body: The Teal accent is never decorative. It should cover less than 5% of any screen, indicating focus, active path, or major action.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: All dataset counters, timestamps, risk values, and bounding box coordinates use monospace text with tabular-nums enabled.

dos: Do align all layouts to the 4px grid increments.
Do use monospace typography for frame indices, sequence numbers, and coordinates.
Do preserve the dark Canvas color (#090d10) for page bodies.
donts: Don't use decorative hairline grid backgrounds on text-rich pages.
Don't use thick colored accent stripes (side-tabs) on card borders.
Don't animate width, padding, or margin properties during state transitions.
